change: Opt-in snapshot-retention benchmark and findings; no application behavior change.

fixture.contents: 100 directories with 10000 empty regular files each; measured fanout path only

method.processes: 15 fresh sequential processes, plus one separate paused vmmap capture process
method.ordering: three rounds of single, cache, scope, navigation; then three repeat runs; then vmmap capture
method.cache_state: warm/uncontrolled, after fixture creation and exploratory scans; not flushed
method.options: auto-summary false; includeHiddenFiles true/false/true and treatPackagesAsDirectories false/false/true for three scans; no fixture hidden files or packages
method.ownership: separate non-inlined frame with explicit snapshot lifetimes; no benchmark list holds finished snapshots
method.execution: scanner async work uses its normal scheduling; cache and navigation operations and all reported checkpoints run on the main thread
method.settling: 100 ms after all tested owners release, before a diagnostic all-zone pressure-relief call
method.units: bytes except seconds and counts; report tables use decimal MB; vmmap uses its own displayed suffixes
method.footprint_and_reusable: task_vm_info.phys_footprint and task_vm_info.reusable; sampled counters have different accounting rules from RSS and heap allocations
method.malloc: malloc_zone_statistics(nil, ...) sums all zones; size_in_use measures outstanding heap bytes, size_allocated reports reserved allocator memory
method.allocator_relief: malloc_zone_pressure_relief(nil, 0), benchmark only; every recorded call reported zero released bytes

phase_seconds.stored_N: synchronous cache.store, including eviction at N=2
phase_seconds.released: synchronous navigation.updateScanContext(nil); meaningful destruction measurement in navigation scenario only
phase_seconds.other: not timed; zero is a placeholder

method.scope_limitations: scanner output, cache, and WorkspaceNavigationModel only; excludes full SwiftUI rendering, browser indexes, chart actors, archives, comparisons, incremental checkpoints, and memory-pressure notifications

environment.RADIX_BENCH_RETENTION_SCENARIO: single, repeat, cache, scope, or navigation
